inventory.notes: When --juggler-pipe is on the command line, reads PW_PIPE_READ and PW_PIPE_WRITE from the environment, parses them with atoi, and adds them to the child's inheritable handles. Windows only. Movable: the ~14-line block can move into an own helper with a one-line call here (plus the two added includes <io.h> and <stdlib.h>). The comment says the handles are resolved earlier in wmain (nsWindowsWMain.cpp): CONFIRMED and that file is covered in the modified list (toolkit/xre/nsWindowsWMain.cpp:127-135 sets PW_PIPE_READ/PW_PIPE_WRITE when --juggler-pipe is given and PW_PIPE_READ is not already set). The comment documents a first-launch crash (0xC0000409) when the parent names the handles and fd 3 is closed; kept as juggler. Invalid env values reach atoi and become handle 0 with no check (visible in the diff: atoi(pipeRead)); the block only runs if GetEnvironmentVariableA found both variables.
